answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 45225 Country: India Title: Taharah Question: Is it proper to put the clothes for washing in laundry (where various clothes were washed and water used is not known and how the clothes were dried is also not known. Answer ID: 45225 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 729/729/M=1434) In case you get your clothes washed in laundry if there is strong probability of purity then the clothes shall be considered pure. But if the probability is of impurity then they shall be considered impure. And merely on the ground of doubt it will not be ruled as impure. If someone is cautious it is better. (Fatwa Darul Uloom 1/280, Fatawa Mahmoodiya 5/271 Dabhel) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
